name: stratagate-memory
description: Local-first, source-traceable cross-session memory for Codex, powered by the shared StrataGate engine. Auto-recall on UserPromptSubmit, incremental L5 capture on Stop, and evidence-gated MCP retrieval tools.

interface.longDescription: Records completed conversations and tool results into local SQLite, recalls them before each prompt, and exposes evidence-gated MCP retrieval tools. Sources are always preserved for verification.
capabilities: Automatic memory recall on each prompt
